thread:
Ava: Quick micro-poll to brighten the afternoon — 2 quick things: 1) submit a 2-line office-plant haiku, 2) winner gets to pick the team Slack mug emoji for the week. :seedling: Ready, set, go.
Samir: Im in. tiny haiku, big vibes :raised_hands: 
Jordan: rules: keep it short and caffeinated. also i vote for a mug emoji that steams aggressively :coffee:
Priya: ok gonna drop mine in 30s. also shoutout to Lina for restocking the beans earlier :sparkles: 
Ava: love the shoutout — haiku entries so far: none, but we have hype. Lina: flags are up, beans are safe. :sunglasses: 
Samir: submission: Mug on the windowsill
Warm code and colder meetings — sip. :mug_with_steam: 
Jordan: submission: Leaves gossip softly
spills of sunlight and sugar on lips :seedling: 
Priya: submission: Fern hums at 3pm
my mug remembers last night's bugs :coffee: 
ops-bot: deploy-bot: FYI kitchen-microwave is OOS until 3pm for maintenance. :warning:
Ava: noted re microwave, thanks ops-bot. brings snacks into question.
Lina: also someone left a mystery Tupperware labeled 'definitely not jam' in the fridge. proceed with caution. :face_with_monocle: 
Samir: voting window: react with :mug_with_steam: for Samir, :seedling: for Jordan, :coffee: for Priya. quick reactions please.
Jordan: dropping :seedling: :seedling: :seedling:
Priya: :coffee: :coffee: :coffee:
Ava: :mug_with_steam: :mug_with_steam:
Samir: totally flexible with the emoji pick. if i win imma pick something gloriously dramatic. :crown:
Priya: tally time looks close. also can we please not actually 3D-print a mug trophy Jordan. or do. no pressure. :laughing: 
Jordan: i will not rule out the possibility of a tiny filament mug. 
Facilities: Facilities Bot: Noted the microwave maintenance. Will confirm for next week if a mini trophy procurement is feasible. 
Lina: i will defend my mug like a tiny flag. take it if you dare. :smirk: 
Ava: results: Samir got the most :mug_with_steam: reactions. Samir, you are hereby crowned Mug Emoji Curator for the week. :tada: 
Samir: honored to accept. selecting :mug_with_steam: as official theme. also free mini celebratory coffee on me at 4pm in the kitchen. first come first served. :coffee: 
Priya: micro-win, big morale. also reminder to label your mugs if you care about them. 
Jordan: 1-line mic drop to close thread: coffee solves immediate problems. End of transmission. :rocket: 
Ava: thread closed. thanks team, much better than an actual meeting. :heart:
